description: This file contains a highly optimized NEON implementation of a quantized 8-bit GEMM kernel used in PyTorch's QNNPACK backend. It performs matrix multiplication for 4 output rows by 8 columns with quantization and requantization steps, utilizing ARM NEON intrinsics for vectorized processing.
